turns.question: How do I report a pothole on my street?
turns.answer:

The city encourages residents to help take care of the community by reporting issues like potholes through this easy process. turns.question: What share of the Geneva urban renewal tax increment does the Redevelopment Agency capture?
turns.answer: The Redevelopment Agency captures 75% of the tax increment from the Geneva Urban Renewal Project Area. [1][2][6] The Agency's participation rate is 75%. [2][6] The remaining 25% of the tax increment passes through to the taxing entities. [3][4][5] The Agency's participation rate is capped at $300 million. [1]

turns.question: Is there a cap on what it can collect?
turns.answer: Yes, there is a cap on what the Redevelopment Agency can collect from the Geneva urban renewal tax increment. [1] The Agency's participation rate is capped at $300 million. [1] This cap applies to the total amount of tax increment the Agency can capture, not to the annual amount. [1] The cap is not related to the 75% participation rate, which is the share of tax increment the Agency captures from the taxing entities. [2] The Agency will stop capturing tax increment if it reaches the $300 million cap, even if it has not reached the end of the 40-year period. [1]
